# expiring at 2026-09-26T12:00:00Z (the Y4 24h batch limit) or when its PR merges.
# A merged PR never runs again, and a NEW PR on the same branch has a new number,
# so the PR binding is what makes "expires on merge" hold. Nothing may be ADDED:
# the guard's self-test refuses an entry that expires after the cap or a table
# holding more than 8 rows. Owners drop their roadmap/census edits the next time
# they touch the branch; when they do, delete that row.
